title: Masoom Sakina hai ghame bepidari hai
body:
MASOOM SAKINA HAI GHAM-E-BEPIDARI HAI
Kha kha ke tamache jo tadapti hai Sakina
Saidaniyon ke haq mein qayamat ki ghadi hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek hashr ka aalam hai ayaa’n arz-o-samaa’n mein
Naalo se sakina ki faza sehmi huwi hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Nadaan ka hai kaun bhala poochne wala
Ek bhai hai beemar charaagh-e-sahari hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abbas nahi Qasim-o-Akber bhi nahi hai
Ab khalb-e-sakina pa chhuri gham ki chali hai
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai Kyu ghurkiya deta hai ise zulm ka bani
Aye shimr Sakina meri naazo ki pali hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Abid bhi hai ab tauq-o-salasal mein giraftaar
Afsos ke majboor zamane ka Ali hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Haatho se chhupaya hai Sakina ne jo chehra
Ghurbat mein khadi dekho to darbare shaqi hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehde koi maqtal mein ye abbas-e-ali se
Be gusl-o-kafan lash Sakina ki padi hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pursa jo sakina ko tamacho se mila hai
Zindaa’n mein hai aur us pa ye uftaad nayi hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Zindaan mein bheja jo sar-e-shah jo zalim
Kya khoob tasalli ye sakina ko mili hai
<<MINI>>
Maqtal mein ye Bano ki fughaa’n gooj rahi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Qasim kaho kya bali sakina ka hai alam
Hai ranj-o-mehan dard-o-alam darbadari hai
